## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to pick the bottle with printed white label and place it.

Task description: Use the left arm to place the medicine bottle with a white cap, orange shoulder, and printed white label from the left side of the table onto the blue square mat.

Success criteria: The medicine bottle is horizontally near the center of the blue square mat and placed on the mat rather than suspended; both grippers are open at completion.

## Execution tips

- Grip both sides of the straight cylindrical bottle body corresponding to the upper part of the white label. Avoid the shoulder, cap, and curved base, allowing the pads to contact the side walls and leaving room to place the bottom on the mat.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the bottle at the selected point. Before closing, confirm both fingers are on opposite sides rather than overlapping in the image and pushing the medicine bottle over from one side.
- Approach through the open space on the side of the medicine bottle facing the blue square mat, leaving room for the fingers and wrist to reduce the risk of hitting the green pump bottle behind it or remote at the rear right.
- Keep the bottle opening facing up and lower slowly. Release after its base is supported by the mat, and avoid scraping the body with the fingertips while withdrawing, which could shift or tip it.
